finding: Runner-sync framework claims warn on every task's staged delivery residue, and batch scope validation treats deliverable-like files from a prior completed task as an expansion error until the prior commit lands.
expectedBehavior: Runner-sync and scope diagnostics should distinguish the current task's pending commit window from actual out-of-scope mutation and provide a compact actionable recovery route.
evidenceOrRepro: Repeated ATM_FRAMEWORK_STAGED_RESIDUE_DETECTED and ATM_TASK_SCOPE_EXPANSION_REQUIRED during ATM-GOV-0307/0314/0315/0316/0324; builds themselves succeeded.
followUp: Add a pending-commit-aware diagnostic projection and reduce false-positive residue warnings without weakening scope guards.
